blueprintRows.title: Frontier Sensor Fusion Bench
blueprintRows.mechanic: Compare non-RGB evidence streams, provenance robustness, and failure routing for radar, SAR, event, and geospatial papers.
blueprintRows.themeName: The frontier - new senses and new duties

seedPapers.title: MOS: Mitigating Optical-SAR Modality Gap for Cross-Modal Ship Re-Identification
seedPapers.problem: MOS is about matching ships across optical and SAR imagery. The everyday problem is that optical cameras and radar see the same ship through very different measurement physics.

seedPapers.title: SegEarth-R2: Towards Comprehensive Language-guided Segmentation for Remote Sensing Images
seedPapers.problem: SegEarth-R2 is about turning complex language instructions into pixel regions in satellite and aerial images. The everyday problem is that a request may mention several targets, parts of objects, nested categories, or implicit geography, not just a single simp

seedPapers.title: RAVEN: Erasing Invisible Watermarks via Novel View Synthesis
seedPapers.problem: This RAVEN paper is about erasing invisible watermarks. The everyday problem is that watermark signals can survive in images even when they are not visible to people.

seedPapers.title: MM-OVSeg: Multimodal Optical–SAR Fusion for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation in Remote Sensing
seedPapers.problem: MM-OVSeg is about open-vocabulary segmentation in remote sensing using optical and SAR data. The everyday problem is that clouds or haze can hide optical imagery, while SAR sees different physical structure.

seedPapers.title: GeoViS: Geospatially Rewarded Visual Search for Remote Sensing
seedPapers.problem: GeoViS is about grounding language queries in huge remote-sensing images. The everyday problem is that a target may be tiny inside a kilometer-scale scene, and the query may depend on roads, rivers, relative positions, or distant context.

blueprintRows.title: 3D World Repo Arena
blueprintRows.mechanic: Turn top 3D reconstruction, 4D driving, LiDAR world, and Gaussian repo papers into reproducible geometry/readiness cards.
blueprintRows.themeName: Recovering the 3D world from flat pictures

seedPapers.title: Feed-Forward One-Shot Animatable Textured Mesh Avatar Reconstruction
seedPapers.problem: This paper is about creating an animatable textured head avatar from one image in a single forward pass. The everyday problem is recovering face shape, hair/head regions, and texture without minutes of per-person optimization.

seedPapers.title: Motion-Aware Animatable Gaussian Avatars Deblurring
seedPapers.problem: Motion-Aware Gaussian Avatars Deblurring is about building sharp animatable avatars from blurry videos. The everyday problem is that fast human movement smears frames, and 2D deblurring can disagree across camera views.

seedPapers.title: L2DGS: Low-Light Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
seedPapers.problem: L2DGS is about reconstructing a well-lit dynamic scene from low-light video. The everyday problem is that darkness, motion, shadows, occlusion, and exposure changes all hide the same underlying moving geometry.

seedPapers.title: Flow4DGS-SLAM: Optical Flow-Guided 4D Gaussian Splatting SLAM
seedPapers.problem: Flow4DGS-SLAM is about mapping dynamic scenes while tracking camera motion. The everyday problem is that moving objects confuse a map unless the system separates camera movement from scene movement.

seedPapers.title: Prune Wisely, Reconstruct Sharply: Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting via Adaptive Pruning and Difference-of-Gaussian Primitives
seedPapers.problem: This paper is about making 3D Gaussian Splatting smaller without losing sharp rendering. The everyday problem is that many Gaussians are redundant, but pruning the wrong ones removes real detail.

blueprintRows.title: Video Temporal Repo Lab
blueprintRows.mechanic: Stress video repo papers for long-horizon drift, action localization, hallucination, and tracking recovery.
blueprintRows.themeName: Seeing and making things that move

seedPapers.title: PAM: A Pose-Appearance-Motion Engine for Sim-to-Real HOI Video Generation
seedPapers.problem: PAM is about generating realistic hand-object interaction videos from simulator-accessible inputs. The everyday problem is turning initial and target hand-object poses into a photorealistic video without having a real first frame.

seedPapers.title: Preserving Source Video Realism: High-Fidelity Face Swapping for Cinematic Quality
seedPapers.problem: This paper is about cinematic-quality face swapping. The everyday problem is that swapping identity can break lighting, expression, skin detail, or camera realism from the source video.

seedPapers.title: Back to the Feature: Explaining Video Classifiers with Video Counterfactual Explanations
seedPapers.problem: This paper is about explaining video classifiers with counterfactual videos. The everyday problem is that to explain why a model saw running instead of walking, the changed video must still look smooth and physically believable.

seedPapers.title: AdaSpot: Spend Resolution Where It Matters for Precise Event Spotting
seedPapers.problem: AdaSpot is about finding the exact moment of an event in video while spending high resolution only where it helps. The everyday problem is that a decisive action may happen in a small region, while most of the frame is irrelevant background.

seedPapers.title: Hierarchical Action Learning for Weakly-Supervised Action Segmentation
seedPapers.problem: Hierarchical Action Learning is about segmenting actions in video from only ordered transcripts, not timestamps. The everyday problem is that the model knows the action order but must infer where each action starts and ends.

blueprintRows.title: Generation Control Repo Studio
blueprintRows.mechanic: Compare code-backed generation papers on prompt control, restoration fidelity, one-step synthesis, and artifact containment.

seedPapers.title: GDPO-SR: Group Direct Preference Optimization for One-Step Generative Image Super-Resolution
seedPapers.problem: GDPO-SR is about one-step image super-resolution that still preserves fine local texture. The everyday problem is enlarging a low-resolution image while making smooth regions clean and textured regions sharp.

seedPapers.title: Bridging Fidelity-Reality with Controllable One-Step Diffusion for Image Super-Resolution
seedPapers.problem: CODSR is about one-step super-resolution that looks realistic without losing faithfulness to the low-quality input. The everyday problem is that generative priors can invent detail, but pure fidelity can leave images blurry.

seedPapers.title: Resolving Endpoint Underfitting in Diffusion Bridges via Noise Alignment
seedPapers.problem: This diffusion-bridge paper is about fixing weak performance near the clean endpoint of an image-restoration path. The everyday problem is that a model can learn most of the journey from degraded to clean but still miss the final sharp correction at the target

seedPapers.title: Low-Rank Residual Diffusion Models
seedPapers.problem: This paper is about restoration when the damaged image is already close to the desired image. The everyday problem is that standard diffusion wastes effort generating everything, even though only a small correction may be needed.

seedPapers.title: Residual Diffusion Bridge Model for Image Restoration
seedPapers.problem: This paper is about restoring damaged images without disturbing clean regions. The everyday problem is that a restoration model should repair degradation locally rather than repaint the entire image.

blueprintRows.mechanic: Use VLM repo papers to adjudicate caption correctness, grounded sorting, evidence anchoring, privacy, and fairness claims.
blueprintRows.themeName: Teaching machines to see and talk at once

seedPapers.title: FedAFD: Multimodal Federated Learning via Adversarial Fusion and Distillation
seedPapers.problem: FedAFD is about federated learning across clients with different modalities, tasks, and model shapes. The everyday problem is letting participants collaborate when their local evidence and architectures do not match.

seedPapers.title: Towards Cross-Modal Preservation, Consistency and Alignment for Privacy-Preserving Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
seedPapers.problem: This privacy-preserving visible-infrared person re-identification work is about recognizing the same person across day and night cameras while hiding private appearance details. The everyday problem is that anonymization can erase the very body structure neede

seedPapers.title: GraphVLM: Benchmarking Vision Language Models for Multimodal Graph Learning
seedPapers.problem: GraphVLM is about testing how vision-language models handle graph-structured multimodal data. The everyday problem is reasoning about nodes and links when each entity may also have images and text.

seedPapers.title: ReCALL: Recalibrating Capability Degradation for MLLM-based Composed Image Retrieval
seedPapers.problem: ReCALL is about preserving multimodal reasoning when adapting an MLLM to composed image retrieval. The everyday problem is that compressing a reasoning model into one retrieval embedding can erase fine relations like red bag on the left but with a different st

seedPapers.title: See It, Say It, Sorted: An Iterative Training-Free Framework for Visually-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning in LVLMs
seedPapers.problem: See It Say It Sorted is about improving multimodal answers without new training. The everyday problem is that a model may generate fluent but weakly grounded reasoning unless it repeatedly checks visible evidence.

blueprintRows.title: Perception Parts Repo Bench
blueprintRows.mechanic: Turn repo-backed segmentation, scene graph, collaborative perception, and few-shot recognition papers into part/localization tests.
blueprintRows.themeName: Naming and locating what's in the picture

seedPapers.title: Focus on Background: Exploring SAM's Potential in Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation
seedPapers.problem: This few-shot medical segmentation work is about using background cues, not only foreground prompts. The everyday problem is that two medical structures may look similar, and the surrounding tissue can be the clue that separates the target from lookalikes.

seedPapers.title: Denoise and Align: Towards Source-Free UDA for Robust Panoramic Semantic Segmentation
seedPapers.problem: DAPASS is about adapting a segmentation model to panoramic 360-degree images without source training data. The everyday problem is that panoramic projection distorts scale and shape, while noisy pseudo-labels can lock the adapted model into wrong classes.

seedPapers.title: TF-SSD: A Strong Pipeline via Synergic Mask Filter for Training-free Co-Salient Object Detection
seedPapers.problem: TF-SSD is about detecting common salient objects across image groups without labeled training. The everyday problem is that zero-shot mask proposals are noisy, and the system must find which masks point to the same meaningful object across images.

seedPapers.title: TAPE: Task-Adaptive Prototype Evolution in Audio-Language Models for Fully Few-Shot Class-Incremental Audio Classification
seedPapers.problem: TAPE is about learning new audio classes from a few examples without forgetting old ones. The everyday problem is that a new sound category may have only a handful of clips, and the original training audio may no longer be available.

seedPapers.title: EReCu: Pseudo-label Evolution Fusion and Refinement with Multi-Cue Learning for Unsupervised Camouflage Detection
seedPapers.problem: EReCu is about finding camouflaged objects without clean labels. The everyday problem is that the object is designed by nature or texture to look like its background, so noisy pseudo-labels can either spill past the boundary or erase fine detail.

blueprintRows.title: Embodied Control Repo Drill
blueprintRows.mechanic: Cover the underrepresented embodied theme with code-backed driving, GUI-agent, and manipulation policy drills.
blueprintRows.themeName: Using vision to act in the world

seedPapers.title: Reliable Policy Transfer for Safety-Aware End-to-End Driving with Deep Reinforcement Learning
seedPapers.problem: This driving work is about transferring a reinforcement-learned policy safely across towns and weather. The everyday problem is that a car policy can behave well in one simulator setting but become brittle when uncertainty, road layout, or traffic interactions

seedPapers.title: Saliency-Guided Representation with Consistency Policy Learning for Visual Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
seedPapers.problem: This paper is about unsupervised reinforcement learning from vision. The everyday problem is that an agent must learn useful behavior without rewards, so it needs to focus on visually important parts of the scene.

seedPapers.title: EnergyAction: Unimanual to Bimanual Composition with Energy-Based Models
seedPapers.problem: EnergyAction is about composing one-hand actions into two-hand actions. The everyday problem is that two hands must coordinate, not just duplicate independent motions.

seedPapers.title: Dynamic Important Example Mining for Reinforcement Finetuning
seedPapers.problem: The paper is about choosing which training examples matter right now. The everyday problem is that a lesson that was useful yesterday may be too easy or misleading after the learner changes.

seedPapers.title: HiconAgent: History Context-aware Policy Optimization for GUI Agents
seedPapers.problem: HiconAgent is about GUI agents that remember what they already did. The everyday problem is that a screen action only makes sense in the context of previous clicks, fields, dialogs, and state changes.

blueprintRows.themeName: Learning more from less, and not breaking

seedPapers.title: What Do Visual Tokens Really Encode: Uncovering Sparsity and Redundancy
seedPapers.problem: What Do Visual Tokens Really Encode is about finding which image patches in a transformer actually carry useful information. The everyday problem is that a model may spend equal effort on sky, wall, object edge, and repeated texture even though many tokens say

seedPapers.title: NuWa: Deriving Lightweight Class-Specific Vision Transformers for Edge Devices
seedPapers.problem: NuWa is about shrinking vision transformers for edge devices. The everyday problem is that an edge camera may only need a few object classes, so carrying a full general model wastes memory and power.

seedPapers.title: FOZO: Forward-Only Zeroth-Order Prompt Optimization for Test-Time Adaptation
seedPapers.problem: FOZO is about adapting a model at test time on devices that cannot afford backpropagation. The everyday problem is that the model faces a shifted environment, but computing full gradients is too expensive in memory and time.

seedPapers.title: CHEEM: Continual Learning by Reuse, New, Adapt and Skip – A Hierarchical Exploration-Exploitation Approach
seedPapers.problem: CHEEM is about deciding how a continual learner should change its architecture for each new task. The everyday problem is that some tasks should reuse old knowledge, some need new capacity, some need adaptation, and some parts should be skipped.

seedPapers.title: Towards Stable Federated Continual Test-Time Adaptation in Wild World
seedPapers.problem: This paper is about adapting federated models to changing unlabeled client data. The everyday problem is that each client sees shifts at different times, and noisy test-time updates can destabilize the shared model.
